[b]EEHP Compliance[/b]
[i]In order to comply with the EEHP charters latest regulations, new legislation has been passed that implements the following changes.[/i]

- At midnight on April 13th, 1% tariffs will come into effect on all EEHP members

-The police force will transfer all criminal records to the new database

-All EEHP member citizens that do not have a criminal record will be allowed into and out of the country without a visa, however for permanent residency or citizenship they will still have to provide a valid visa

On 14th April 2025, the great parliamentary assembly approved order #768, allowing the military to begin the mass mobilisation of troops and supplies. These troops and supplies will be transferred by boat to [nation]Italian dutch[/nation], then massed at the border, in Gatonia base. The troops will eventually be deployed to Sal-Baliz for a mass invasion. It is estimated to take 2 months to transfer all the required supplies and personnel to Gatonia base.
